testcase.name: TC1 - Basic Flow (Happy Path)
testcase.preconditions: The iTrust2 user has authenticated themselves in iTrust2 UC2.

step.actions: patient: The patient enters information about the appointment request and presses the Submit Request button . HCP Date Time Comments Type
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM A message confirms the request.

testcase.name: TC2 - Alternative Flow 1: Views their appointment request
testcase.summary: Alternative Flow 1: Views their appointment request
testcase.preconditions: The iTrust2 user has authenticated themselves in iTrust2 UC2.

step.actions: patient: The patient views their appointment request. The patient can select a request and delete the request.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM A message confirms the request.

testcase.name: TC3 - Alternative Flow 2: Views appointment requests
testcase.preconditions: The iTrust2 user has authenticated themselves in iTrust2 UC2.

step.actions: hcp: The HCP views appointment requests. The HCP can select to approve or decline the requestion. The appointment will no longer be visible in the patient's appointment request view.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM A message confirms the request.

testcase.name: TC4 - Alternative Flow 3: View upcoming appointments
testcase.preconditions: The iTrust2 user has authenticated themselves in iTrust2 UC2.

step.actions: hcp: The HCP view upcoming appointments.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM A message confirms the request.

testcase.name: TC5 - Exception Flow 1: Invalid data field format
testcase.summary: Exception Flow 1: Invalid data field format
testcase.preconditions: The iTrust2 user has authenticated themselves in iTrust2 UC2.

step.actions: patient: The patient enters information about the appointment request and presses the Submit Request button . HCP Date Time Comments Type
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM prompts the patient or HCP to correct the format of a required data field because the input of that data field does not match that specified in Section 6.6.
